name: i4_2l_na
source: Plausible 2.0 L naturally aspirated DOHC 16V gasoline I4, NOT a specific engine. Full-load curve shaped after the published manufacturer data range for this class (about 105-116 kW at 6000-6500 rpm, 190-200 N*m at 4000-4600 rpm; e.g. the Mazda MZR 2.0 / Toyota 3ZR / Honda R20 class - brochure ranges, verify before citing a specific engine). Peak 200 N*m at 4500 rpm, about 114 kW at 6000-6100 rpm. Motoring (closed-throttle) torque from a Heywood-style SI friction correlation fmep ~ 0.97 + 0.15(N/1000) + 0.05(N/1000)^2 bar plus about 0.9 bar closed-throttle pumping mep, scaled by V_d/(4*pi) = 15.9 N*m/bar (Heywood, Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, ch. 13 - check the equation number before citing); the 0 rpm value is the Coulomb part. Inertia 0.16 kg*m^2 = crank + flywheel + clutch cover, typical 0.12-0.20 for this class. Idle-control gains sized for a ~9 rad/s, zeta ~0.9 idle loop (PHYS-033 I3 plan section 6.1). Starter: ~1.2 kW class referred to the crank. PHYS-033 I3.
